name: craftory
description: An SDLC framework, built on top of Matt Pocock's skills, as a mod. A phase rail above the prompt takes a feature from idea to merged PR (Align, Spec, Tickets, Build, Review, Ship, Retro).

rail.title: SDLC phase rail
rail.description: Show the SDLC phase rail above the prompt

rail_layout.title: Rail layout
rail_layout.description: A row of phases, or one summary chip

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Light or dark colours in the terminal; auto follows the Claude Code theme. Desktop and mobile follow the system appearance

ascii_glyphs.title: ASCII glyphs
ascii_glyphs.description: Draw the rail with plain characters (> x ! v) for terminals that draw symbols two cells wide
